  ***NOTES;***

      **Host page ( They can switch between viewing as a Host or guest at the top)**

1. Hosts will have a profile of their personal bio information and can edit it anytime. They can click on their profile picture to edit their profile.  
2. In the host page, the user can choose if they are hosting a party or if they are listing a property (to be used for an event/party spot)  
3. The host will have a “**host**  account". They can see a page to see all their listings and edit it or add new listings.   
4. Each of the host’s listings information will be fetched on the user/guest dashboard and classified according to related categories. E.g if the host is listing a yacht party, it should be shown under the yacht party category of the user dashboard and its location.  
5. Hosts can choose if they are hosting a party or listing a property (i.e a place/location spot) and will upload the details of the listings, its capacity, location, rules, write the description, amenities, upload exciting moment photos of the location, price etc. and they can edit or update it anytime later in their profile.  
6. Hosts can list as many party or property listings as they want and they can edit or update each one individually at any time.  
7. Hosts can switch between **Host** account and **Guest** account each with their own specific tools to do things.  
8. **Hosts** will have a wallet where they will receive their earnings earned from their listings and can withdraw it to their bank account and **Guests** will have a wallet to deposit money into to use and pay for bookings and reservations. (My virtual account number will be there for the guest’s wallet deposits. This can be done later)  
9. When the user switches to view as a host, it'll switch their entire account between a host and they can switch back as a guest. They will get full different tool access when they are viewing as a host vs as a guest to operate in the app.  
10. Add a side menu button that shows all the settings options like wallet account, host earnings, guest payments, wish/loved list, profile, Language and currency, booked Trips, contact support etc. just like Airbnb has.  
11. TRD’L; Users can choose between **host a party** and **list a property** when they click on the **become a host** button. After they have switched to the **host page**. They will need to fill some different required information when they’re **hosting a party** vs **listing a property**  
12. Add an API that concerts the current automatically between NGN, USD, EURO and GBP when the user clicks on the currency icon on the footer a pop-up will show asking him to choose his currency between this currencies I mentioned only.
